98:1: Those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not going to separate until the clear proof came to them.
98:2: A messenger from Allah recites purified pages.
98:4: Those who were given the Book fell into division only after the clear proof came to them.
98:5: They were only commanded to worship Him, making religion sincere to Allah, as hanifs, to perform the salah, and to give the zakat. That is the upright religion.
98:6: Indeed, those who disbelieved from among the People of the Book and the polytheists are in the fire of Hell, abiding therein forever; they are the worst of creation.
98:7: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds, they are the best of creation.
98:8: Their reward with their Rabb is the Gardens of Adn beneath which rivers flow, abiding therein forever; Allah is pleased with them and they are pleased with Him; this is for whoever fears his Rabb.
